class.name: InputSettingsServer
class.brief_description: Settings server for input: sensitivity and inversion per device, deadzone, vibration, toggle actions and the input options of the engine.

method.name: apply_to_mouse_motion
method.description: Returns [param relative] (the motion of an [InputEventMouseMotion]) with the mouse sensitivity, inversion and smoothing applied. With [member InputSettings.mouse_smoothing] above [code]0.0[/code], the result is blended with the previous result, so call it once per motion event; [method reset_mouse_smoothing] forgets the previous result.

method.name: apply_to_stick
method.description: Returns the position of a stick with the radial deadzone, the gamepad sensitivity and the gamepad inversion applied. Inside [member InputSettings.gamepad_deadzone] the result is [constant Vector2.ZERO]; outside, the length is rescaled so that it starts at [code]0.0[/code] at the edge of the deadzone and reaches [code]1.0[/code] at full tilt, before the sensitivity is applied. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var look = InputSettingsServer.apply_to_stick(Input.get_vector("look_left", "look_right", "look_up", "look_down", 0.0)) [/gdscript] [csharp] Vector2 look = InputSettingsServer.ApplyToStick(Input.GetVector("look_left", "look_right", "look_up", "look_down", 0.0f)); [/csharp] [/codeblocks] [b]Note:[/b] Pass the raw stick position (deadzone [code]0.0[/code]), otherwise the deadzone is applied twice.

method.name: apply_to_vector
method.description: Returns [param vector] multiplied by the sensitivity of [param device], with its inverted axes negated. No deadzone and no smoothing.

method.name: get_first_player_device_id
method.description: Returns the pending value of [member InputSettings.first_player_device_id].

method.name: get_gamepad_deadzone
method.description: Returns the pending value of [member InputSettings.gamepad_deadzone].

method.name: get_look_vector
get_mouse_smoothing
method.description: Returns the pending value of [member InputSettings.mouse_smoothing].

method.name: get_sensitivity
method.description: Returns the pending sensitivity of [param device]: [member InputSettings.keyboard_sensitivity], [member InputSettings.mouse_sensitivity] or [member InputSettings.gamepad_sensitivity].

method.name: get_toggle_actions
method.description: Returns the pending value of [member InputSettings.toggle_actions].

method.name: get_vibration_strength
method.description: Returns the pending value of [member InputSettings.vibration_strength].

method.name: is_action_active
method.description: Returns whether [param action] is active. For an action in [member InputSettings.toggle_actions], each press switches it on or off; for all other actions it is [method Input.is_action_pressed]. Call it every frame (from [method Node._process] or [method Node._physics_process], not both) so that no press is missed; several calls in one frame return the same state.

method.name: is_emulating_mouse_from_touch
method.description: Returns the pending value of [member InputSettings.emulate_mouse_from_touch].

method.name: is_emulating_touch_from_mouse
method.description: Returns the pending value of [member InputSettings.emulate_touch_from_mouse].

method.name: is_keyboard_allowed_for_current_player
method.description: Returns the pending value of [member InputSettings.allow_keyboard_for_current_player].

method.name: is_mouse_confined
method.description: Returns the pending value of [member InputSettings.mouse_confined].

method.name: is_player_event
method.description: Returns whether [param event] belongs to the first player: joypad events if their device is [member InputSettings.first_player_device_id] (or that is [code]-1[/code]), [InputEventAction] always, keyboard, mouse and touch events if [member InputSettings.allow_keyboard_for_current_player] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: is_toggle_action
method.description: Returns whether [param action] is in [member InputSettings.toggle_actions].

method.name: is_using_accumulated_input
method.description: Returns the pending value of [member InputSettings.use_accumulated_input].

method.name: is_vibration_enabled
method.description: Returns the pending value of [member InputSettings.vibration_enabled].

method.name: is_x_inverted
method.description: Returns whether the horizontal axis of [param device] is inverted.

method.name: is_y_inverted
method.description: Returns whether the vertical axis of [param device] is inverted.

method.name: reset_action_states
method.description: Switches all toggle actions off, for example when a level starts or the player dies.

method.name: reset_mouse_smoothing
method.description: Forgets the previous result of [method apply_to_mouse_motion], for example after a teleport or when the mouse is captured again.

method.name: set_allow_keyboard_for_current_player
method.description: Sets [member InputSettings.allow_keyboard_for_current_player].

method.name: set_emulate_mouse_from_touch
method.description: Sets [member InputSettings.emulate_mouse_from_touch]. It takes effect at once.

method.name: set_emulate_touch_from_mouse
method.description: Sets [member InputSettings.emulate_touch_from_mouse]. It takes effect at once.

method.name: set_first_player_device_id
method.description: Sets [member InputSettings.first_player_device_id].

method.name: set_gamepad_deadzone
method.description: Sets [member InputSettings.gamepad_deadzone]. The value is clamped to [code]0.0[/code] to [code]0.95[/code].

method.name: set_mouse_captured
method.description: Sets [member Input.mouse_mode]: [constant Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED] if [param captured] is [code]true[/code] (gameplay), otherwise [constant Input.MOUSE_MODE_CONFINED] if [member InputSettings.mouse_confined] is [code]true[/code] and [constant Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE] if not (menus). The mouse mode itself is not stored, because the game switches it all the time. [b]Note:[/b] On the Web, capturing the mouse needs a user gesture such as a click, and browsers do not support [constant Input.MOUSE_MODE_CONFINED].

method.name: set_mouse_confined
method.description: Sets [member InputSettings.mouse_confined]. It takes effect at the next call of [method set_mouse_captured].

method.name: set_mouse_smoothing
method.description: Sets [member InputSettings.mouse_smoothing]. The value is clamped to [code]0.0[/code] to [code]0.95[/code].

method.name: set_sensitivity
method.description: Sets the sensitivity of [param device]. The value is clamped to [code]0.01[/code] to [code]10.0[/code].

method.name: set_toggle_actions
method.description: Sets [member InputSettings.toggle_actions]. Empty names and duplicates are removed, and all toggle actions are switched off.

method.name: set_use_accumulated_input
method.description: Sets [member InputSettings.use_accumulated_input]. It takes effect at once.

method.name: set_vibration_enabled
method.description: Sets [member InputSettings.vibration_enabled].

method.name: set_vibration_strength
method.description: Sets [member InputSettings.vibration_strength]. The value is clamped to [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code].

method.name: set_x_inverted
method.description: Sets whether the horizontal axis of [param device] is inverted.

method.name: set_y_inverted
method.description: Sets whether the vertical axis of [param device] is inverted.

method.name: vibrate
method.description: Starts a vibration of the joypad [param device] with [method Input.start_joy_vibration], with both magnitudes multiplied by [member InputSettings.vibration_strength]. Does nothing if [member InputSettings.vibration_enabled] is [code]false[/code] or the strength is [code]0.0[/code]. [b]Note:[/b] On the Web, joypad vibration depends on the browser.

constants.constant: The keyboard: [member InputSettings.keyboard_sensitivity], [member InputSettings.keyboard_x_inverted] and [member InputSettings.keyboard_y_inverted].
The mouse: [member InputSettings.mouse_sensitivity], [member InputSettings.mouse_x_inverted] and [member InputSettings.mouse_y_inverted].
The look stick of a gamepad: [member InputSettings.gamepad_sensitivity], [member InputSettings.gamepad_x_inverted] and [member InputSettings.gamepad_y_inverted].
